declarations.name: PerspectivePanel
declarations.summary: Perspective workspace whose data connection and layout are configured by a serializable prop.

attributes.name: hideTabs
attributes.description: Hide the viewer's internal tab strips and reclaim their space. False by default. Does not hide the wrapper toolbar or remove panels; applications provide channel navigation when needed.

attributes.name: find
attributes.description: Enable a column/value filter prompt for Ctrl+F or Cmd+F in the focused Datagrid, and a Find toolbar button. Disabled by default.

attributes.name: rowActions
attributes.description: Table-name to row actions. Indexed columns accept {action, label, text?, icon?} or a list. Dedicated @ identifiers accept {header, position: start|end, buttons: [...]}. Icons: copy, delete, add. Buttons emit perspective-row-action; applications own confirmation, authorization and mutations. Grouped/split or unindexed rows are disabled.

attributes.name: toolbar
attributes.description: Show the channel picker, close button, and Copy selection button. Channels are configured by table name in config.channels.

attributes.name: themes
attributes.description: Theme names offered by the status-bar picker; light/dark map to Pro Light/Pro Dark.

attributes.name: autosize
attributes.description: Auto-size mode (on by default); disable to drive resizes imperatively.

attributes.name: autopause
attributes.description: Auto-pause rendering while the element is not visible (on by default).

attributes.name: throttle
attributes.description: Render throttle in milliseconds; unset restores adaptive throttling.

attributes.name: settings
attributes.description: Whether the settings sidebar is open.

events.name: perspective-row-action
events.description: A row button was activated. Detail contains action, panel, table, column, and typed record key. No data is mutated automatically.

events.name: perspective-click
events.description: A datapoint was clicked; detail carries the row context.

events.name: perspective-global-filter
events.description: A cross-panel global filter was applied from a selection.

events.name: perspective-global-filter-update
events.description: The global filter set changed; detail carries the filters.

events.name: perspective-config-update
events.description: The viewer configuration changed (layout drag, view edit, filter); use to persist user-edited workspaces.

events.name: perspective-toggle-settings
events.description: The settings sidebar opened or closed.

events.name: perspective-table-delete
events.description: A bound table was deleted on the server.

events.name: perspective-ready
events.description: One-shot: the panel connected, loaded its tables, and applied and rendered its initial workspace config.

events.name: perspective-error
events.description: A config apply failed (connection, mirror, or restore); detail carries the error.

events.name: perspective-copy-error
events.description: Selected-cell copying failed or the native Copy menu is unavailable over HTTP. Detail contains message and error; applications choose their notification UI.

methods.name: exportData
methods.description: Export CSV (default) or JSON text without synthetic action value columns. Options: panel (defaults to active panel), format (csv or json). Retains filtering, sorting, grouping and expressions; exports the configured view, not a selected block. The temporary view is deleted after export.

methods.name: openFind
methods.description: Open the column/value filter prompt for the active panel when find is enabled.

methods.name: copySelection
methods.description: Copy the focused grid's selected text. Call directly from a user gesture. Resolves true on success, false on cancellation, no selection, or failure.

methods.name: openChannel
methods.description: Open a configured channel by table name, reusing its last view configuration. Uses the wrapper's restore queue.

methods.name: closeChannel
methods.description: Close a configured channel by table name and retain its view configuration in saved workspace data.

methods.name: saveClean
methods.description: Save open and closed channels without session themes or column size overrides. Use with spaday's Invoke action to persist or export the workspace.
